cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.50%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -1.91%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -17.20%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +16.18%, EOSE +6.60%, PWR +4.59%, BE +4.09%, ARRY +2.95%. Laggards: ENPH -17.20%, SEDG -9.51%, BKR -6.22%, NOV -5.35%.
